title: phyla nodiflora var. subsessilis
intro: Phyla nodiflora var. subsessilis, commonly known as Wild Algerian tea or Mexican tea, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Phyla nodiflora var. subsessilis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing and the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Phyla nodiflora var. subsessilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
